summary: Iteration 9 re-verify. Blackjack race fix: PASS. Over 3 probe runs (player 30 rounds x16 parallel, player 20 rounds x32 parallel, admin 20 rounds x24 parallel at the same time), I sent 63 active hands mixed hit/stand/double calls at once: 0 wallet mismatches (delta == total_payout - total_stake), exactly 1 casino_games record per hand (nonce+user_id), 0 stuck locks, 0 open hands left. Unknown game_id -> 404, foreign user's game_id -> 404, a fresh lock -> 409, a stale lock (>15s) is recovered -> 200 and released. pytest test_blackjack.py: 16/16 pass. House Games strip: PASS. scrollbar-width is none, offsetHeight == clientHeight (no scrollbar gutter) at 1920 and 390. A horizontal wheel scrolls it (scrollLeft 0 -> 88, the max) and on mobile scrollBy works (scrollWidth 976 > clientWidth 366). No page-level horizontal overflow. Blackjack resume: PASS. After a reload during a hand with side bets 0.02/0.03/0.04, the side inputs are restored and disabled, and bj-total-bet shows 'Total bet 0.19 USDT' (stake + sides). After stand, Deal is back and inputs are enabled again.

minor.issue: Legacy docs with lock=True and no lock_at are never recovered (the stale check needs lock_at < stale) and return 409 forever. None exist in the DB right now (count 0), so this is theoretical. Optionally add {lock_at: {$exists: false}, lock: {$nin:[None,False]}} to the stale branch.

Edge case: double/split/insurance take the wallet deduction BEFORE the token-guarded save. If the lock is stolen by stale recovery (a request taking >15s), the save raises 409 and the extra stake is already deducted and never refunded. Also, a crash between _bj_save and _bj_settle leaves a 'done' hand that was never paid or recorded. Low probability; consider refunding on save failure.

issues: With the scrollbar hidden, desktop mouse users (vertical wheel only, no trackpad) have no obvious way to scroll. Only the cut-off last card hints there is more. Consider an edge fade or prev/next arrows, or mapping the vertical wheel to horizontal scroll (optional).

action_items: Optional: handle legacy lock=True docs without lock_at in the stale-recovery query
Optional: refund the double/split/insurance deduction if _bj_save fails with 409

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~2200 lines; split the casino/blackjack logic into its own module
The lock token + token-guarded replace_one + settle-after-save design is correct; the release in finally is token-scoped, so it can no longer release another request's lock
